source: The Big Lead: How to access the Pirate Shop (Nov 1, 2026)
text:
On top of that, if you’re in a squad and someone on your team opens a chest and gets the Pirate Token, all squad members will get it too.
During the redemption periods, currently listed as Nov 1 – Dec 16 and Jan 1 – Dec 16, 2027, you can cash in your Pirate Token to access the Pirate Shop.
Once claimed, this will last for 14 days before the shop reverts to normal and you’ll need to start paying for stuff again. There are a few exceptions, namely: Real-money offers (rather than things that cost V-Bucks), Gifts, Battle Pass levels, or Sidekicks you already own, but aside from that, everything is completely free for the taking.
